independent_audit.scope: Independent saved-logit score and complete-output audit; no neural-network recomputation.

interpretation: Passes declared validation gate: 501 exact,35 gains,0 losses. Matches all exact answers available in frozen four-path pool, not every oracle-best-F1 answer. No integration, final-test or serving-performance claim.
limitations: Independent-Bernoulli score is a fixed heuristic, not evidence of calibration.
Cached candidates retain their prior generation cost; incremental head time is not serving latency.
Oracle availability is descriptive; labels never enter the selector.
Eligibility is not oracle parity, protected-test evidence or serving promotion.
scope: Frozen four-candidate symmetric-head set reranking; validation only
selector: Canonical ascending product-ID math.fsum of symmetric logits; eligible paths only; lowest-rank ties; rank1 failed fallback
